purpose: Fill audited CG and location gaps while preserving the Japanese Gal cel-shaded visual canon.
canonDecisions: Arcane Sovereign keeps the accepted male visual identity and all conflicting pronouns are normalized to 他.
Noctia uses seal magic rather than a sword; the F10 action text now matches the established costume and CG language.
Last Custodian uses the female deep-teal-haired act3_last_custodian identity rather than crown_magus.
Vela and Seph dialogue rows use their own runtime IDs instead of borrowing Serena and Lumi art.
runtimeDecisions: Eight new CGs and five new empty backgrounds are exported as 1672x941 WebP and bound to exact story beats.
CG hold spans keep a decisive illustration visible across the complete text beat without duplicating file references.
Checkerboard standee sources are not runtime referenced; existing transparent identity-correct map art remains the safe fallback until native alpha extraction is supplied.
All eight initially accepted CG compositions received a second simplification pass; temporary redraws with baked blank dialogue panels were rejected, and the final v3 images contain no UI.
F3, F6, F12, F15, F26, F29 and F30 background mappings were corrected to match their written locations.

rejections.reason: the cape did not visibly shelter the letters
guardian network count was not exactly seven
story and identity were correct, but costume ornament and material detail exceeded the requested restrained Gal cel finish
simplified drawing was acceptable but the generator painted a blank dialogue panel into the image
excess ornament and effect noise exceeded the series render limits
generator returned baked opaque backgrounds rather than a native alpha channel
